## Personality

Bright, impulsive and stained to the elbows. She talks about colours the way others talk about friends.

## Story

Hawise dyes cloth on the riverbank in vats of every colour, and her husband the miller complains the river runs purple on Tuesdays. She is trying to make a new colour for the cloth merchant's festival.
